stage: Outcome-free baseline cohort extension and treatment-context audit
registration: Exploratory follow-up informed by prior v0.9. New extended-cohort recovery outcomes must not be read in this stage. This is not external preregistration.
objective: Replace current-admission discharge sepsis-code selection with observable pre-index infection context, evaluate common treatment setting and source coverage. Do not assume a larger cohort or causal comparison will result.
base: One first observed target-drug initiation per admission; adult; no prior other target drug or simultaneous first use; valid admission interval and alive at t0; t0 in icustays; latest available unique platelet value <100 in prior24h, chart<t0 and store<=t0. Select explicit baseline columns only. Discharge sepsis code is an audit descriptor, never eligibility.
platelet_audit: Reproduce v0.9 feasibility from platelet_measurements, independently rebuild from raw cached target_labs using all qualifying known source rows, earliest available duplicate storetime, unique value at latest eligible time. Report discrepancies. Do not inspect future platelet values.
sources: Fresh phase10 caches from raw microbiologyevents, transfers and actual medication/support records for the extended candidates. Do not infer absent values from old sepsis-limited caches. Preserve old caches and hashes.

microbiology.date_only: Conservative next midnight availability, flagged separately. Result content only when stored by t0.
microbiology.screening: SCREEN or SURVEILLANCE in specimen/test descriptions; excluded from diagnostic evidence.
microbiology.routine_bacterial_culture: Create explicit test-name taxonomy from available names before outcome analysis. Routine bacterial cultures separated from mycobacterial/fungal cultures, viral/molecular/antigen/serology tests, screening, and uncertain labels. Preserve all diagnostic-microbiology flags as a broader sensitivity descriptor.
microbiology.known_VRE: Available prior7d vancomycin-R Enterococcus or explicit VRE organism label. Record screening vs diagnostic source; any prior known VRE excluded as conservative comparability restriction, not proof of VRE infection.
microbiology.linkage: hadm match; missing-hadm samples only assigned by same patient within admission interval, exclude ambiguous multi-admission matches.

location: Explicit careunit transfer interval contains t0, no conflicting non-ICU unit and exactly one ICU unit. Derive shared ICU units within each candidate population without outcomes.
medications: Actual target administration rechecked at t0. Prior medications require chart/start<t0, store<=t0. Reuse v0.9 beta-lactam dictionary; ICU positive delivered amount/not Rewritten, eMAR recognized administration, IV route and no explicit zero without positive. Record route/coverage rather than assuming prescriptions are administrations.
readiness: Describe population size, independent patients, repeats, new admissions vs original, care-unit/drug overlap, available organism/source categories, eMAR and ICU source coverage, baseline laboratory/severity proxies. No endpoint/event-count based selection. If a defensible cohort is retained, write its next-stage model/outcome plan before new outcome comparison.
claims: At most critically ill patients with baseline thrombocytopenia and pre-index documented infection evaluation. No Sepsis-3 diagnosis, common anti-MRSA indication or independent clinical replication unless separately established.
